questions.text: Jaspreet deposited a sum of ₹12,800 at 5% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. The total amount (in ₹) received by Jaspreet after 2 years will be:
Which of the following options is correct when two objects at the same temperature are kept in contact with each other?

options.text: Heat is transferred from object 2 to object 1.
Both objects transfer heat to each other.
Heat is transferred from object 1 to object 2.

questions.text: In a business, Tushar invests in ₹10,000 and Salil invests in ₹20,000. Tushar received 10% of the profit for managing the business and the rest of the profit is divided in the ratio of their capitals. Find Tushar's share of the profit (in ₹) in a profit of ₹14,400.

The taxi charges in a city consist of a fixed charge together with the charge per kilometre for the distance covered. For a distance of 35 km, the charge paid is ₹375 and for a distance of 48 km, the charge paid is ₹427. Find the fixed charges and the charge per km (in ₹), respectively.
The HCF of two numbers is 62, and the other two factors of the LCM of these factors are 7 and 9. Which of the options given below can be a possible value of the smaller of the two numbers?
The floor of a rectangular hall has a perimeter of 220 m. If the cost of painting the four walls at the rate of ₹10 per m2 is ₹11,000, then find the volume of the hall.
Find the value of 96.86572 × 107.
A boy goes to school at a speed of 5 km/hr. He returns at a speed of 14 km/hr. He takes a total of 8 hours for both going to school and returning. The distance (in km) between his home and school is:
If 11.6 : x :: x : 2.9, and x > 0, then find the value of x.
The areas of three adjacent faces of a solid cuboid are 162 cm2, 144 cm2 and 50 cm2. What is the volume (in cm3) of the cuboid?

Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster pair.)
A fruit seller had some apples. He sells 40% of the apples and now has 900 apples. How many apples did he originally have?
Akshay gets 2% increase in his sale amount in the first year and 25% in the second year. With that his present sale is ₹1,42,800. What was his sale (in ₹) two years ago?
Which of the following is an effective way to prevent electrical accidents in the workplace?

options.text: Working on live wires with bare hands
Using water to cool overheated electrical equipment
Using insulated tools and wearing rubber gloves

questions.text: Which technology operates through an electrochemical process that transforms the energy stored in hydrogen gas (H2) and oxygen into electrical power without combustion?
Which of the following steps is essential when configuring a web browser to enhance both security and privacy for a user?

options.text: Setting the homepage to a frequently visited website for quick access
Enabling pop-ups for all websites to improve user experience
Configuring the browser to block third-party cookies and enabling HTTPS-only mode
Disabling the browser's cache to improve website loading times

questions.text: A can complete a piece of work in 18 days. B can complete it in 14 days. With the assistance of C, they completed the work in 7 days. C alone can complete it in ______________ days.
Calculate the energy possessed by an object of mass 10 kg when it is raised to a height of 5 m from the ground. Given: g = 9.8 m s-2.
In a certain code language, ‘BORE’ is coded as ‘8624’ and ‘TABS’ is coded as ‘3217’. What is the code for ‘B’ in the given code language?
Seema is twice as old as Alka. If nine years is subtracted from Alka’s age and six years is added to Seema’s age, then Seema will be four times Alka’s age. How old was Alka three years ago?

Rakesh starts a business with a capital of ₹2,50,000. He incurs a loss of 5% during the first year. However, he makes a profit of 4% on his remaining investment during the second year. Finally, he makes a profit of 20% on his new capital during the third year. Find his total profit at the end of three years.
Which of the following is an example of uniform motion?

options.text: A ball rolling down a slope
A train moving at a constant speed on a straight track
A sprinter running a 100-metre race with varying speed
A vehicle moving through a crowded area

questions.text: A person saves 50% of his income. If his expenditure is ₹640, then his income (in ₹) is:
Which of the following is NOT one of the 5S principles?
How many base units are given in the SI system?
